items.summary: Handoff: keep the gated product private; attach the consolidated read-only rights, data-flow, retention, consent, vendor, and incident evidence bundle; keep the permission request unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private. Evidence: official API access mechanics are documented, but permission to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize returned data is not established; current public terms point against those uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, privacy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible fleet growth is conditional where consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, terms, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Existing progress includes official source documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable because authoritative rights, operator-confirmed retention and user workflows, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log/vendor inventory, incident/request procedures, and counsel review remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, alert and operational data flows, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep the permission request unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price-use limits, and affiliate or advertising permission. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel and owner review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table, including deletion, correction, access, processor, consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; capture deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional treatment without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; produce a read-only log-field, retention/access, vendor/DPA, incident, and request-procedure inventory. No data-use item is clear or conditional enough to support public launch.

Fleet compliance and data-quality review: the compliance scan is technical evidence only, with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown sites and open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is broadly available but has permission/configuration gaps; revenue covers one day and the $4.92 aggregate commission cannot be assigned to sites. These facts support conditional ordinary growth only, not a fleet-wide legal clearance or financial claim. Do not close compliance, data-quality, analytics, revenue, site, or launch-readiness gates without site-specific evidence.
